newForecast.stockNote: 300 SKUs are flagged above Max, but the cash is concentrated: ~€90K of excess is quantified on the largest (the alert's projected 'excess €' over-states, so isn't summed). The ~€0.40M slow tail sits below a wide Max (illustrative). Counts are SKU counts; € validated on top stock-value SKUs.
newForecast.mapeTitle: Forecast accuracy — 3-month MAPE by ABC class
newForecast.mapeNote: Median 3-mo MAPE, sampled SKUs per class. A & B (steady movers) forecast reasonably (~35–45%); C degrades sharply — intermittent demand inflates the %. Manage C with buffers, not forecast precision.

classNote.text: projected stock stays above Flowlity's Max buffer over the coming months (not cleared by near-term demand) → act now (cancel PO / destock).
Slow stock below a wide Max:
stock sits below Max but, at current demand, won't be consumed within ~12 months — the Max ceiling is set too wide to flag it → review / tighten the buffer, then destock.

trend.title: Stock value — last 12 months

rightBody.text: Stock value held in a €3.0–3.4M band over the year and sits at €3.20M now — broadly stable.
No structural build-up or draw-down: the inventory base is steady, so the opportunity is mix (above-max + buffers), not the overall level.

trend.note: Stock value held €3.0–3.4M, now €3.20M — broadly stable.
